description.en: Mr Dixon's drinking fountain on the green: the lion's head of green slate, the fresh water from the fell, free for everyone, thirsty walkers, their dogs on a lead and the horses, a jug to fill, the children splashing, and the water frozen on a winter morning.
description.sl: Pitnik gospoda Dixona na vaški zelenici: levja glava iz zelenega skrilavca, sveža voda s hriba, brezplačna za vse, žejni pohodniki, njihovi psi na povodcu in konji, vrč za napolniti, otroci, ki pljuskajo, in zamrznjena voda na zimsko jutro.
description.it: La fontanella del signor Dixon sul prato del paese: la testa di leone di ardesia verde, l'acqua fresca dal monte, gratis per tutti, gli escursionisti assetati, i loro cani al guinzaglio e i cavalli, una brocca da riempire, i bambini che schizzano, e l'acqua ghiacciata in una mattina d'inverno.
description.de: Herrn Dixons Trinkbrunnen auf der Dorfwiese: der Löwenkopf aus grünem Schiefer, das frische Wasser vom Berg, kostenlos für alle, durstige Wanderer, ihre Hunde an der Leine und die Pferde, ein Krug zum Füllen, die Kinder, die spritzen, und das gefrorene Wasser an einem Wintermorgen.

words.example_en: The water comes out of the lion's mouth.
words.example_it: L'acqua esce dalla bocca del leone.
words.example_de: Das Wasser kommt aus dem Maul des Löwen.
words.note: A lion's head, with 's: the head of a lion. Many old fountains have one.
words.note_sl: A lion's head, z 's: glava leva. Mnogi stari vodnjaki jo imajo.
words.note_it: A lion's head, con 's: la testa di un leone. Molte vecchie fontane ne hanno una.
words.note_de: A lion's head, mit 's: der Kopf eines Löwen. Viele alte Brunnen haben einen.

words.example_en: Don't talk with your mouth full!
words.example_it: Non parlare con la bocca piena!
words.note: One mouth, two mouths. An animal's mouth is a mouth too: the lion's mouth.
words.note_sl: Ena usta, množina mouths. Tudi živalski gobec je v angleščini mouth: the lion's mouth.
words.note_it: Plurale mouths. Anche la bocca di un animale è mouth: the lion's mouth.
words.note_de: Plural mouths. Auch das Maul eines Tieres ist mouth: the lion's mouth.

words.note: With be: I'm thirsty (not I have thirst). Hungry is the same: I'm hungry.
words.note_sl: Z be: I'm thirsty (ne I have thirst). Enako hungry: I'm hungry.
words.note_it: Con be: I'm thirsty (non I have thirst, come «ho sete»). Lo stesso con hungry: I'm hungry.
words.note_de: Mit be: I'm thirsty (nicht I have thirst wie «ich habe Durst»). Genauso hungry: I'm hungry.

words.note: Irregular: drink, drank, drunk. A drink is a noun too: Have a drink!
words.note_sl: Nepravilni glagol: drink, drank, drunk. Drink je tudi samostalnik (pijača): Have a drink!
words.note_it: Irregolare: drink, drank, drunk. Drink è anche un nome (una bevanda): Have a drink!
words.note_de: Unregelmäßig: drink, drank, drunk. Drink ist auch ein Nomen (ein Getränk): Have a drink!

words.example_en: The horse drinks from the basin.
words.example_de: Das Pferd trinkt aus dem Becken.
words.note: A small horse is a pony, like Bonny. One horse, two horses.
words.note_sl: Majhen konj je pony, kot Bonny. En konj, dva: horses.
words.note_it: Un cavallo piccolo è un pony, come Bonny. Plurale: horses.
words.note_de: Ein kleines Pferd ist ein Pony, wie Bonny. Plural: horses.

words.example_en: The water is fresh and cold.
words.example_de: Das Wasser ist frisch und kalt.
words.note: Fresh water: clean and new, from a spring. Fresh bread: baked today.
words.note_sl: Fresh water: čista voda, naravnost iz studenca. Fresh bread: danes pečen kruh.
words.note_it: Fresh water: acqua pulita, appena presa dalla sorgente. Fresh bread: pane di oggi.
words.note_de: Fresh water: sauberes Wasser, frisch aus der Quelle. Fresh bread: Brot von heute.

words.note: Freeze, froze, frozen. On a very cold day: It's freezing!
words.note_sl: Freeze, froze, frozen. Na zelo mrzel dan: It's freezing! (strašno mrzlo je)
words.note_it: Freeze, froze, frozen. In una giornata gelida: It's freezing! (si gela!)
words.note_de: Freeze, froze, frozen. An einem eiskalten Tag: It's freezing! (es ist eiskalt)

words.note: Splash is the noise too: splash! Splashing in a puddle is great fun.
words.note_sl: Splash je tudi zvok: pljusk! Splashing in a puddle: čofotanje po luži.
words.note_it: Splash è anche il rumore: splash! Splashing in a puddle: saltare nelle pozzanghere.
words.note_de: Splash ist auch das Geräusch: platsch! Splashing in a puddle: in Pfützen planschen.

words.example_en: The water is free for everyone.
words.example_de: Das Wasser ist für alle kostenlos.
words.note: Free: it costs nothing. The Victorian fountains gave clean water to everyone, free.
words.note_sl: Free: nič ne stane. Viktorijanski vodnjaki so vsem dajali čisto vodo zastonj.
words.note_it: Free: non costa niente. Le fontanelle vittoriane davano acqua pulita a tutti, gratis.
words.note_de: Free: es kostet nichts. Die viktorianischen Trinkbrunnen gaben allen sauberes Wasser, kostenlos.

words.note: Fill it up: right to the top. Full is the adjective: the jug is full.
words.note_sl: Fill it up: do vrha. Full je pridevnik: the jug is full (vrč je poln).
words.note_it: Fill it up: fino all'orlo. Full è l'aggettivo: the jug is full (la brocca è piena).
words.note_de: Fill it up: bis oben hin. Full ist das Adjektiv: the jug is full (der Krug ist voll).

words.example_en: Keep your dog on a lead.
words.example_de: Halte deinen Hund an der Leine.
words.note: A dog's lead rhymes with need (in America: a leash). Near sheep, keep your dog on a lead.
words.note_sl: Pasji lead se rima z need (v Ameriki: leash). Ob ovcah imej psa na povodcu.
words.note_it: Il lead del cane fa rima con need (in America: leash). Vicino alle pecore, tieni il cane al guinzaglio.
words.note_de: Die Hundeleine, lead, reimt sich auf need (in Amerika: leash). Bei Schafen nimm den Hund an die Leine.
